name: Theadre
speaker: entity:theadre
lines: Bother me not, outsider. I have nothing to say to your like.
Oh King... Won't ye lift your people from this watery grave?...
The King who will cast aside the aspersions fabricated by your kind...
Who else, Kin? The King of prophecy. He who shall rise [Etrea](faction:etrea) from the waves of obscurity... And bring us back to those bygone days of the Old World.
He is no King... But I know that what he does is all in the name of [Etrea](faction:etrea). Surely, when the King returns, he will vacate the throne..
Oh King... Do you hear our calls? Do your hear our cries for help?

A god? Amongst men, perhaps. The King shall be the vessel of Mur's light - he who once commanded the Murmur greater than any other. It is said that his Ardour could cut the seas themselves... But where are you now, oh King?...
Aye... Eldest mother of our people, Mur Of Light... She who descended from the Heavens and brought out the Light of our souls in our darkest days...

Only through many battles and many voyages... Some say that the king struck a bet with Mur and won her heart, and all of us in this Kingdom her Light... Some day, we'll see it again. I'm sure of it...
Oh... The light of you... it's as if the King were standing before me... Truly, you are blessed by Mur's light...
